execution_precondition.rule: If the development gate does not pass, this confirmatory design is not executed and no fresh outcomes are accessed.

fresh_slice.selection_algorithm: Python random.Random(20260820).sample over task IDs arb-wide-0001..arb-wide-0400 after excluding the 24 development IDs; result sorted by numeric task ID

execution.comparison: contemporaneous matched run of baseline and candidate on the exact same 48 tasks
execution.transport_handling: typed; failed provider calls remain failures and cannot be converted to empty evidence
execution.required_transport_validity: all planned provider requests complete with OK status for both systems

primary_outcome.metric: official per-task recall, paired candidate-minus-baseline mean difference
primary_outcome.uncertainty: paired nonparametric bootstrap over tasks, 20000 resamples, seed 20260820, percentile 95% CI
primary_outcome.positive_rule: mean recall delta >= 0.02 AND 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0

secondary_guardrails.absolute_zero-hit_tasks: report for both systems; never omitted

multiplicity: single primary confirmatory contrast; secondary metrics are guardrails, not separately promoted hypotheses

promotion_scope.if_positive: supports fresh external acquisition/discovery benefit on AutoResearchBench Wide only; does not by itself establish ORION closure-authority residual, stopping safety, or transfer
promotion_scope.if_nonpositive: retain archived narrowed paper and bounded development findings; no threshold relaxation or resampling of a different fresh slice

forbidden: running the fresh slice if Dev-2 development eligibility is not achieved
changing selected task IDs after any fresh outcome access
changing candidate or baseline implementations after any fresh outcome access
relaxing the 0.02 recall margin or bootstrap rule after outcomes
using the 24 development tasks in confirmatory statistics
calling same-backend query formulations independent routes
